intentional_structural_misses.quote: That combination of people and technology has always been central to Schwab and cannot be underestimated.
intentional_structural_misses.why: No figure and no cash, sweep, or agent keyword, so the code filter never emits it.

intentional_structural_misses.label: Sweep cash excluding short credits fell $12.5 billion, as a Schwab sentence
intentional_structural_misses.quote: sweep cash excluding short credits fell $12.5 billion
intentional_structural_misses.why: Schwab does not say this. The finance tab recomputes it from the June and September releases. Extraction correctly does not invent it.

baseline_versus_pipeline.note: No model was called. Latency of a live one-prompt baseline was not measured.
baseline_versus_pipeline.baseline_shape: one prompt over the whole cache, no code checks before the answer
baseline_versus_pipeline.tradeoff: A one-prompt baseline is one call. It does not run the six code checks, so the seeded errors ship. The pipeline's catch rate is the code checks. Speed without those checks is a real tradeoff, not a win.
